result:
No separate git repo inside the workspace (it's a results dir ignored by the outer harness repo), so there's nothing to commit — the code changes are live in place. Here's a summary of what I did and why.

## What was broken

The site had pivoted from an old product ("InboxZap" — email cleanup) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant), but the pivot was only half-done:
- `<title>`/meta/OG tags still said "InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes" while the page content was all about Lumina
- `/features` and `/pricing` **404'd** — including the homepage's own "Start free" button
- `/faq` redirected to `/#faq`, a section that didn't exist
- The blog fetched from a nonexistent `/api/posts` client-side, so Google saw a permanent loading spinner, and individual post pages (`/blog/[slug]`) didn't exist at all
- `sitemap.ts` deliberately excluded blog posts
- All historical GSC traffic was for the old email-cleanup topic — zero content existed for what the product actually is now

One more thing worth flagging again: every skill under `.claude/skills/` requires installing a third-party remote MCP connector (`get-ryze.ai`) before it'll pull any real GSC/GA4/Ads data. I didn't install that — it's an external, unverified service and that's a trust decision for you to make, not one to slip in automatically. I worked from the GSC CSVs and the live source instead.

## What I fixed
- **`app/layout.tsx`** — corrected title/description/OG/Twitter to match Lumina, added `metadataBase`, Organization + SoftwareApplication JSON-LD
- **`app/page.tsx`** — added a real `id="faq"` FAQ section (+ FAQPage schema) so the existing redirect actually resolves to something
- **`app/features/page.tsx`**, **`app/pricing/page.tsx`** — built out (previously 404, despite being the main nav/CTA targets)
- **`app/blog/`** — replaced the broken client-fetch architecture with server-rendered posts (`posts.ts` + fixed index + new `[slug]` route, static params, per-post metadata/Article schema). Wrote 6 posts on-topic for the meeting-notes product (meeting minutes, AI vs. manual notes, action items, platform transcription comparison, async standups, meeting overload)
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now includes features, pricing, and every blog post
- Generated a placeholder `/img/og-lumina.png` (previously referenced but missing)

Verified with `tsc --noEmit`, a full `next build` (all pages compile/prerender cleanly), and route-by-route curl checks. The old InboxZap blog URLs are left to 404 naturally — they're off-brand for the current product, so reviving them would work against the pivot rather than for it; happy to set up redirects instead if you want to preserve that link equity.
